title: Chapter 926
paragraphs: Chapter 926
230. Invasion and Attack(7)
For a while, Phaelito took time to recover his eyes and ears on the spot.
However, Jin's party was unable to seize this moment to attempt an attack.
They also had to regroup and regain their bearings.
Dante was spitting blood from the aftermath of forcefully unleashing his Emperor's Sword, and Hedo was trying to regain his distorted senses due to the Netherworld Sword and Flash Bomb.
“Real teeth, huh...... Yes, I suppose it's not just the power you were fortunate to acquire that got you here.”
Clang-!
Phaelito resumed his attack first.
He had already fully recovered his vision damaged by the flash bomb.
Every time Phaelito fired his sword energy, an afterimage remained in every direction.
“Jin, don't worry about me. Just focus on your area!"
Hedo was unable to properly counter the sword energy scratching his entire body.
Nevertheless, the reason he insisted was because he knew that Jin, who lost the Heart of Light, was not as robust as before.
There was no time for a reply. Jin parried the sword energy of Phaelito flying in front of him.
The crescent-like sword energy shattered as it poured to the left, but the shock pounded Jin through his Bradamante's Sword Aura.
“But that doesn't mean you can defeat me. With such a weakened body, you can't even run away from me, Jin Runcandel.”
A sensation of bones and flesh bursting from the inside.
Actually, nothing had exploded.
Even if the Heart of Light had lost its function, the physique blessed by Runcandel, the body that he had been training daily, was Jin's from the beginning.
And the will to move that body was also his.
“Don't underestimate me, Phaelito. Even if we can't live for ten thousand years like you, there are people here whose spirits will never fade.”
“Those are indeed plausible words to hear. But words don't carry power. If you want to overcome the reality that is me, you simply need to possess a stronger force than mine.”
Phaelito crouched down and stretched his Basakala downward.
The motion of gathering strength and raising the sword, Jin and his comrades naturally thought that Phaelito was trying to emit sword energy more vigorously in all directions.
So they quickly deployed the protective shield and bulged their eyes, but what Phaelito had spread out with his sword was not aimed at the party.
The Sword Demon Style Five
Heaven Destroying Slice 1st Form
Kaaaaa-!
What Phaelito had thrust with a shout was the sky.
It was the protective barrier of Ayula that still covered most of the airspace of the Holy Kingdom and the confrontation with Talaris.
As the Heaven Destroying Slice spread, Jin and his companions couldn't help but raise their heads unknowingly to confirm its appearance.
A sight they had never seen before, and was not recorded in any history, that was enormously gigantic.
The cross-shaped sword energy divided the sky into four.
The Heaven Destroying Slice cast a sharp shadow not only on the Belrium plains, but also to the end of the Holy Kingdom's maritime territory.
[Khaaak!]
Murakan screamed in shock.
Even though the previously deployed spirit curtain blocked the shock once, it seemed as if the scales all over his body were about to fall off.
Even then, the Heaven Destroying Slice did not directly touch Murakan.
What made Murakan scream right now was the shock wave that originated from the Heaven Destroying Slice.
Jin's party felt their sight blurring white for a moment and instinctively thrust their swords into the ground.
It was to withstand the tremendous suction force formed with the Heaven Destroying Slice.
However, the ground was collapsing due to the force Phaelito applied when he unfolded the Heaven Destroying Slice.
It flipped over like a sea struggling in rapids, and it flowed down mixing around like soft dough.
Senses faded as if thrown into a vacuum state.
The party members called out and looked for each other, but they could only see a space that had turned entirely white or black.
Jin, Murakan, Hedo, Dante.
If they weren't the ones with such power, they would have already been disassembled without a trace and scattered somewhere in the distorted space.
“Heuk...!”
How much time had passed?
Jin was finally able to hear his own voice.
As he exhaled, it felt like blood was spurting like a thunderbolt inside him. His hair stood on end and his body stiffened.
For a moment, Jin was in a defenseless state.
At that moment, if Phaelito had rushed in, he would certainly have been unable to stop it, surely he would have lost his life.
The same was true for his companions. They all lost consciousness for a moment.
Fortunately, Phaelito hadn't been able to find them in the meantime.
Having split the sky in two with only two sword strikes, he had no strength left to do anything else for a moment.
"Hoo."
Phaelito took a breath and looked up at the sky where the Heaven Destroying Slice had passed.
Through his eyes darkened with madness, he saw the protective shield of Ayula beginning to collapse completely.
The shield split into a cross and dropped golden debris.
Just a moment ago, that power had protected the Holy Kingdom as the will of Ayula.
Now, the debris pouring across the kingdom like a snowstorm had become a disaster in itself.
Thump-! Thump-!
The falling fragments struck the ground of the Holy Kingdom like undiminished meteors, digging deep and breaking apart.
The buildings erected by the citizens crumbled lifelessly upon impact with the fragments, and the people inside disappeared without a trace from the heat and shock.
Most didn't even realize the moment of their death.
In some ways, it was better to meet their end like that, without a moment to feel pain or sorrow.
Those who were lucky to dodge the debris, or those who were inside the shields spread by the clergy, were about to face the sight of people randomly dying from golden fragments all over.
And the sight of demons beginning a massive descent onto the ground as soon as Ayula's protective shield collapsed.
"It's time to return our bodies to Lord Zito, kill all the humans you see!"
"Pain will lead you to order! Today, we will own the ground!"
Countless demons were storming down to the ground riding the debris of the protective shield.
They massacred ordinary humans as easily as stepping on bugs.
They tore the heads off those who ran, trampling down on those who hesitated.
A hell had opened in the Holy Kingdom.
Jin, being in the Belrium plains, could not see that spectacle with his own eyes.
But he could tell even without seeing.
The sight of innocent people calling out the name of Ayula and collapsing mercilessly, the despair and pain that had descended on the Holy Kingdom, and the fear of those who were being tormented.
They were pressing in.
They were tearing into Jin's inner self.
More sharply than Phaelito's sword that had constantly threatened his life, more fiercely it was scratching at Jin.
No torture could be more terrible than this.
His trembling eyes seemed to be melting. Tears were welling up.
But no matter how many tears he shed, no matter how much he suffered, this despair would not be soaked and hidden.
And Phaelito was piercingly looking at Jin.
After all, what the Vamel Union always sought to protect first were ordinary people, and the Demon Realm knew that fact well.

"Jin Runcandel. I can feel your shivering tremble so clearly. But no matter how much I think about it, I can't understand. Why is it so painful that bugs, who are not so precious, who have nothing to do with you, die."
How dare you say that you can suffer as much as I do, who lost Sakiel......!
Phaelito's face, which yelled out, was stained with tears of blood.
Then he spat out a mouthful of blood and closed his mouth tightly.
The poison of rage and loss was surging.
Sakiel's death was a poison that could not be expelled, no matter how much he spat it out.
Kelliark had penetrated Phaelito's inner self more accurately than Phaelito himself.
Phaelito spat out a hollow laugh looking at the divine blood in his palm, and then shook his hand.
"I can't acknowledge that sorrow. You should not suffer so much from such a trivial thing, the price for killing Sakiel must be more cruel."
Jin was listening to Phaelito's voice from the crevices of the cracked ground.
Unlike Phaelito, he did not cry.
Crying should come after the fight is over, when no one can see him.
First of all, Jin checked the communicator in his arms.
Even though it was in the armor made of ancient eternal iron, there were signs of it being crumpled and damaged here and there.
Even if he got out of the blocked area formed by Phaelito, it was in a state where it could not operate.
"Murakan!"
Jin shouted, stepping up from the gap.
Immediately, Phaelito's sword energy flew in, and Jin ducked his body and checked the location of his companions.
Dante and Hedo were more than a thousand steps away.
They had just started moving, but because of Phaelito's magic and sword energy, they couldn't easily approach the center of the battlefield.
Murakan slipped out of the torn aura curtain and descended to Jin, transforming into a human.
"You go to Sungwangseong for support."
"What?"
"If Sungwangseong collapses now, they get the Eye of Zito. Talaris is probably not in good condition either, so you have to go."
"Even if my close combat is hampered by aura blockage and my influence in the battle is low, I should be the one to retreat when it's time to...!"
"People are dying. But we can't think about what's behind and fight. Either way, whether Sungwangseong is pushed and the Eye of Zito is snatched, or we die here by Phaelito, it's the same."
"Damn."

"If Ridolros and Bideluche are summoned together from that large fissure, or if only Ridolros comes out, then you can come back here. But if only Bideluche is summoned, you have to defend Sungwangseong by any means."
Ridolros Trinak, Bideluche An. The strongest demon kings of the Demon Realm after Phaelito.
Among them, Ridolros was a member of Viseps.
"...Kid, it looks like the summon just finished?"
Jin and Murakan looked up at the sky.
Unfortunately, the demon who escaped from the large fissure was just one person, Bideluche An.
As soon as the summon was completed, Bideluche looked down at the Bellium Plains with a smirk.
"Oh my, Phaelito. You're playing with interesting kids? Ah, it's that bastard who killed Sakiel?"
Despite his playful tone, his voice had the power to shake the entire battlefield.
"Go retrieve Lord Zito's body, Bideluche."
"Ah, I also want to take a bite, but I can't touch your prey. Enjoy slowly, I'll take good care of Lord Zito's Eye."
Fwaaah!
Bideluche spread his wings and crossed the dark sky.
"Follow him quickly!"
Grinding his teeth, Murakan transformed back into his original form and chased after Bideluche.
At this speed, Bideluche would reach Sungwangseong in an instant and kill Talaris and Lani.
[Don't die, kid!]
Jin didn't respond and gripped his sword tighter.
Phaelito was approaching.
